messages:
claire: Quick thread to lock the benchmark narrative for the launch sprint. Need: 2-3 clean visuals, explicit SLAs called out, and a simple inbound routing plan (quick-probe vs enterprise). Keep copy approachable for PMs and infra buyers.
ryan: Visuals I'd push: 1) cost vs latency scatter (p50 dots, p95 halos) with labeled SLA bands; 2) compact cost waterfall (tokens, compute, infra) per slice; 3) micro-trace example showing history length impact. Try to keep to two panels if we need hero + detail.
maya: Design constraints: no more than 3 visuals, no tiny labels, annotate measurement conditions. Use our palette, and include small methodology card: QPS, seq len, warm-cache. I'll do the hero if we lock numbers by Wednesday. :art:
oliver: Routing + CTAs: Landing page: quick-probe (paste prompt or pick workload) -> returns estimated p50/p95 + cost range -> self-serve path. Enterprise form collects company, monthly_tokens_est, target_SLA -> webhook to sales. Example rule: `if monthly_tokens_est >= 75_000_000 OR target_SLA == "<500ms" -> route:enterprise`.
design-bot: placeholder CSV attached for mockups. Use as sample only.
```
model,workload,latency_p50_ms,latency_p95_ms,cost_per_1k_usd,avg_history
speedy-lite,consumer_chat,105,250,0.52,24
search-core,search,330,700,0.30,128
quant-rerank,rerank,175,440,0.11,48
```

ryan: Also recommend an inset showing autoscaling economics: cost_per_1k vs QPS tiers to reassure finance/infra buyers about unit predictability.
claire: Webinar hook: "See the hidden economics of real-time inference" — 20m bench story + 20m demo (quick-probe + autoscale) + 10m Q&A. Who can present bench methodology and who demos?
maya: I can own the visuals and the methodology card. Need final CSV and a short copy deck by Thurs noon.
oliver: I'll own the routing implementation and webhook mapping. Will draft the GA events + webhook payload spec by Wed. Suggested GA event: `bench_quick_probe` with props: workload, est_p50, est_p95, est_cost_per_1k.
bench-bot: new run uploaded: s3://redwood-bench/runs/2025-09-03/launch-probe-v1.csv :link:
ryan: Microcopy suggestions: Quick-probe CTA: "Estimate latency & cost in 60s"; Demo CTA: "Watch a 5-min replay for your workload"; Enterprise CTA: "Talk to our capacity team". Keep CTAs short and test phrasing.
claire: Sales asterisk: if we say <200ms for consumer chat, add methodology note: "measured p50 with history <=32 and 10-50 sustained QPS". Oliver, can you add that to the methodology card?
oliver: Yep. Will include measurement footnotes and CRM tag mapping: `tags: [low-latency-interest, high-volume-econ, enterprise]` in webhook.
claire: Action items: 1) ryan = finalize mock CSV + p50/p95 splits by Tue EOD, 2) maya = hero visual + methodology card by Thu noon, 3) oliver = webhook + GA spec by Wed, 4) claire = draft webinar outline + 90s launch post by Wed PM. Reconvene Fri 10am to review. Thanks team :rocket:
